experiment_template.research_question: Can request-local evidence handles preserve exact delivered-evidence selection while reducing GLM-5.3-flash terminal-review input by at least 128 tokens at 8K?
stop_conditions: Any unbounded unknown usage, retry, asymmetric score, integrity failure, or cost-cap violation stops before the next task.
Stop immediately when six eligible pairs become mathematically unreachable.

records.falsifier: Any handle is ambiguous, invented, disclosed with a full read ID, or resolves differently from its private binding; treatment input is not at least 128 tokens lower; any quality metric degrades; aggregate tokens exceed control; or macro Span-F1 gain is below 0.05.
records.mechanism: Assign h0 through h2 to receipt-bound delivered evidence outside the prompt, present only handle/path/range tuples, accept only listed handles in one terminal tool, and resolve them to exact read IDs before provenance validation and export.
records.scope: GLM-5.3-flash fresh scoreable 8K ContextBench development tasks at the 96K cumulative input-plus-output tier.
records.statement: Request-local short evidence handles preserve exact context selection while reducing terminal-review prompt and response tokens.
